entries.subject: The colour of the photosphere
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the published 2,600 K through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer into sRGB with the D65 white. Gaia does not resolve this star from ROXs 42B A, so no spectrum or catalogue row of its own exists; no limb-darkening measurement or model grid in the repository reaches it, so the disc is uniform.
entries.revisitWhen: A spectrum of this star alone is published.
